integrity: The complete result and proof are included with reproducible finite checks. Numerical checks supplement rather than certify infinite mathematics. Priority is a documented best-knowledge assessment, not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed logistic growth parameter one and fixed state-diffusive coupling in [0,1/2], initial points in the open square (0,1/2)^2; no uniform endpoint crossover or global basin assertions. Full historical priority review is incomplete because several early primary articles and the full Hoffman dissertation were inaccessible.
title: Factorial synchronization with a logarithmic-square correction at the critical coupled-logistic extinction point
